head_A.target: future 5-session maximum high reaches signal close +5%

known_weakness.interpretation: Reachability edge is strong but first surface is often late/extended. This weakness must not be repaired by modifying the frozen champion.

head_B.objective: Surface probable future V1R leaders 1-5 sessions earlier, before material extension, without converting the output into a buy signal.

allowed: V1R raw_probability available at decision cutoff
V1R daily rank available at decision cutoff
same-day and trailing price-location state known at decision cutoff
same-day and trailing extension state known at decision cutoff
forbidden: post-open evidence for a prior-close signal
2025 lead-time diagnostics used to retune after inspection

score_design.principle: Smooth ranking, not a brittle hard-gate stack.
components: reachability_strength = within-date percentile rank of frozen V1R raw_probability
rank_acceleration = robust percentile of normalized rank improvement over 1/3/5 sessions
pre_extension_quality = monotone soft penalty as trailing return becomes extended; never a hard delete
price_location_quality = smooth preference for approaching a recent pivot/high without requiring breakout confirmation
score_design.combination_rule: EARLY_SURFACE score must be a pre-registered monotone combination of the four components. Any fitted weights may use 2023 development and 2024 validation only. No 2025 or 2026 outcome may select or rescue weights.
score_design.abstention_rule: Head B may abstain. Lack of a clean early-surface state must produce no shadow alert rather than a forced ranking claim.

surface_levels.shadow_watch: Top-N Early-Surface cohort for research capture only; N must be frozen before prospective evaluation.
surface_levels.champion_intersection: Names already in V1R Top20 remain Head A discoveries and are not counted as new early-surface wins.
surface_levels.new_early_surface: A valid early-surface event must occur strictly before the name first enters frozen V1R Top20.

three_pass_reasoning_locked.pass_1: Preserve V1R as immutable Champion; all earliness work is isolated in Head B.
three_pass_reasoning_locked.pass_2: 2025 lead-time weakness is already known, so 2025 is contaminated for Early-Surface model selection. Use 2023 development and 2024 validation; 2025 is retrospective diagnostic only; Gold evidence begins prospectively.
three_pass_reasoning_locked.pass_3: Radar ends at opportunity discovery. Early-Surface cannot authorize entry. Layer3 microstructure activation is the only new orthogonal gate allowed to decide whether a Radar opportunity becomes executable.

head_B.gold_rule: Prediction must be immutably persisted before the relevant future outcome exists.

primary: median lead-time improvement versus V1R first Top20 surface
T-5/T-3/T-2/T-1 recall before V1R Top20 surface
median trailing 5D return at first Head-B surface
head_B_success_metrics.promotion_principle: Earliness must improve materially without destroying the reachability edge.

industry_pit_policy.rule: Industry-PIT breadth is robustness-only and may not alter Head A or Head B scores. Do not backfill 2025 using current classifications or partial research-output mappings.
industry_pit_policy.blocking_scope: Does not block prospective Radar collection; blocks only claims that industry-PIT robustness has passed.

daily_output_contract.immutable_ledger_rule: Persist the complete scored universe or a manifest-bound full score ledger before outcomes. Never reconstruct historical cohorts from Top-N summaries.

capture_priority: Head-B new early-surface shadow cohort not yet in V1R Top20
hard_rules: Layer3 may consume Radar rank but may not rewrite it.
Head-B shadow status is not buyability.
No D gate, Attention Ranking, B1 rank, manual list, or familiar holding may substitute for a legal Radar cohort.
Microstructure evidence from after market open cannot be back-projected into prior-close Radar scoring.

failure_and_kill_rules.head_A: If future prospective evidence materially contradicts V1R discovery edge, downgrade Champion by versioned governance action; never silently retune.
failure_and_kill_rules.head_B: Kill or keep shadow-only if prospective Gold fails to improve lead time with acceptable reachability/false-positive tradeoff. No 2026 threshold rescue.
failure_and_kill_rules.activation_boundary: Until Layer3 independently passes forward/OOS economic and path-safety gates, Activation Engine remains EMPTY.

next_actions: Freeze exact Head-B scoring/selection recipe using only 2023 development and 2024 validation.
Create immutable daily dual-head prediction ledger schema and writer.
On 2026-10-12 begin prospective Head-A/Head-B predictions before outcomes and route both cohorts into Q012 capture.
Keep industry-PIT robustness PENDING until an authoritative historical artifact is available; do not let it delay prospective collection.
